summary: Ill backpacker unable to hike out near Stillwater Reservoir in the Flat Tops Wilderness; Classic Air Medical flew two RCSAR members in, assessed on scene, then flew the patient to a hospital while RCSAR hiked out with the partner and dogs — all out by nightfall
location: Flat Tops Wilderness near Stillwater Reservoir
responding_agency: Routt County Search and Rescue (mutual aid); Classic Air Medical
notes: RCSAR Far Routt Newsletter Fall Edition Nov-2024; "Sick Backpacker in the Flat Tops Wilderness"; Garfield County
